COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Avoiding all community work

2. Which statement about Negotiation Skills is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Negotiation Skills never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Negotiation Skills.
   C. Explain Negotiation Skills with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Negotiation Skills as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Building Consensus is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Building Consensus never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Building Consensus.
   C. Explain Building Consensus with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Building Consensus as rumours only.

4. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Kisumu

5. Which statement about Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea.
   C. Explain Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im.

7. Which statement about Advocacy in the School Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Advocacy in the School Community.
   B. Treat Advocacy in the School Community as rumours only.
   C. Explain Advocacy in the School Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Advocacy in the School Community never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Civic Dialogue is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Civic Dialogue as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Civic Dialogue.
   C. Explain Civic Dialogue with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Civic Dialogue never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte.
   C. Explain Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte as rumours only.

10. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Name the president
   D. Replace the compass rose

11. Which statement about Intercultural Competence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Intercultural Competence never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Intercultural Competence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Intercultural Competence as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Intercultural Competence.

12. Which statement about Leadership Development is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Leadership Development.
   B. Explain Leadership Development with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Leadership Development never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Leadership Development as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Problem Identification Process and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship 4.1 Social Enterprise  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Implementation and Reflection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
